selection: T1_v3 + T2_v7_guided; final research candidate, not the older single-pass v7/v7.2
limit_boundary: Exact v7 instruction counts summary/strength comments/acknowledges/gap/nextStep. Full render with contextLimits/headings was also measured; observed <=159 in S15C, not a universal guarantee. Do not silently insert v8 wording into frozen v7.
T1_context: task and current only; no history
T2_context: same task/current plus at most one matched previousAnswer/previousFeedback and fallible currentAssessment; no new requirement from history
scoring: Feedback only; no student scores produced or changed. Existing project grading is separate and untouched.
evidence_boundary: S15C/S15D replayed24 source-corrected T1 records; correction was researcher-assisted, not an automatically validated stage or a third LLM call.
source_review_provenance: Source adjudication/correction was conducted by the assistant against Q/C, not by independently recruited teachers. Uploaded human ratings are separate evidence. Source-review/chat effort is not included in experiment API-token totals.
execution: No remote API client/credentials included or invoked; package documentation only.
